title: Searching the Pareto Front: Multi-Objective Retrieval for Heterogeneous Scientific Modalities
abstract: arXiv:2611.23639v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In cosmology, surveys span different sky regions and wavelength ranges, resulting in uneven modality coverage across observational datasets. Such heterogeneity can be addressed through either multimodal foundation models (FMs), which learn shared embedding spaces, or independently learned modality embeddings combined via late fusion. We investigate whether the latter provides an adaptive alternative to FM-based scientific retrieval. We evaluate this approach on a galaxy retrieval task spanning diverse modalities--history of star formation, spectra of light emitted, and multi-wavelength observations from two telescopes--comparing an FM baseline with separately trained embeddings fused through multi-objective optimization based on Pareto optimality. We find that the FM baseline achieves strong embedding-space proximity, but our method preserves modality-specific distance structure that allows scientists to inspect which physical signals dr

translated_title: 搜索帕累托前沿：面向异构科学模态的多目标检索
translated_abstract: 在宇宙学中，巡天观测覆盖不同的天区范围和波长区间，导致各观测数据集之间的模态覆盖不均匀。这种异构性可以通过多模态基础模型（FM，即学习共享嵌入空间）来解决，也可以通过独立学习的模态嵌入并结合后期融合来处理。我们研究后者能否为基于基础模型的科学检索提供一种自适应的替代方案。我们在一个涵盖多种模态的星系检索任务上评估该方法——包括恒星形成历史、发射光的光谱以及来自两台望远镜的多波长观测——将基础模型基线与通过基于帕累托最优性的多目标优化融合的独立训练嵌入进行对比。我们发现基础模型基线能够实现较强的嵌入空间邻近性，但我们的方法保留了模态特定的距离结构，使科学家能够查看究竟是哪些物理信号在驱动（检索结果）。
tldr: 该论文提出基于帕累托最优的多目标优化后期融合方法，将独立训练的各模态嵌入进行融合，在异构模态星系检索任务中相比多模态基础模型基线能更好地保留模态特定的距离结构，为科学检索提供了自适应的替代方案。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Pareto-optimal multi-objective late-fusion approach that combines independently trained modality embeddings, demonstrating that for heterogeneous-modality galaxy retrieval it preserves modality-specific distance structure better than a multimodal foundation model baseline, offering an adaptive alternative for scientific retrieval.
